controls: adult identity variation on stable chassis

productionModel.formula: Body Chassis + narrow stature modifier + identity variables

bodyChassis.name: STANDARD LIGHT
bodyChassis.structuralRead: normal adult skeleton; narrower shoulders/torso; lighter limb volume

bodyChassis.name: STANDARD MEDIUM
bodyChassis.structuralRead: baseline adult Human frame with moderate torso and limb mass

bodyChassis.name: STRONG
bodyChassis.structuralRead: broader shoulders/ribcage and thicker muscular limbs while preserving 5.3-head Human construction

bodyChassis.name: BROAD / HEAVY
bodyChassis.structuralRead: broader torso/pelvis with greater soft-tissue volume over stable adult skeleton
bodyChassis.forbiddenMisread: caricature, scaled-up B02, or muscular B03

invariants: all Human samples use approximately 5.3-head body ratio
stature remains within approximately 0.97–1.03 Human baseline
body variation comes from B01–B04 chassis rather than arbitrary skeleton invention

sampleControls: STRONG female Human without changing anatomy system
same STRONG chassis with a different identity
BROAD / HEAVY female Human without caricature
older identity on STANDARD MEDIUM chassis

forbiddenMisreads: SHORT AVG TALL treated as separate Human body assets
one figure is only a scaled copy of another
women always light and men always strong/heavy
changing head/body ratio to express stature or body type
Human reading as Halfling or Gnome

rejection.reason: mixed face grammar and overly prominent continuous height/body variation in earlier Human draft
rejection.replacementRule: Use exactly four discrete Body Chassis, narrow 0.97–1.03 stature variation, and one Face Grammar across all Human identities.
